alt: A multiset kept as a max-heap with a pending-count table, one column per value seen so far. An add pushes a new heap entry. A remove drops the count immediately and increases that value's pending count, without touching the heap. A query pops stale entries, each one lowering its value's pending count by one, until it finds an entry whose pending count is zero: that is the current maximum, even if another entry with the same value was removed.

steps.caption: Add 3: it goes into the heap as -3. The multiset now holds 1 item.
Add 7: it goes into the heap as -7. The multiset now holds 2 items.
Add 2: it goes into the heap as -2. The multiset now holds 3 items.
Add 9: it goes into the heap as -9. The multiset now holds 4 items.
Add 9: it goes into the heap as -9. The multiset now holds 5 items.
Add 5: it goes into the heap as -5. The multiset now holds 6 items.
Remove 9: count drops to 5 right away, but the heap keeps its stale entry. `pending[9]` becomes 1, so a later query can skip it.
The top of the heap is 9, but `pending[9]` is 1. This entry stands for an item that was removed, so it is discarded and the count stays 5.
The top of the heap is 9 and `pending[9]` is 0, so this entry is still in the multiset. It is the maximum.
Add 4: it goes into the heap as -4. The multiset now holds 1 item.
Add 6: it goes into the heap as -6. The multiset now holds 2 items.
Add 1: it goes into the heap as -1. The multiset now holds 3 items.
Remove 6: count drops to 2 right away, but the heap keeps its stale entry. `pending[6]` becomes 1, so a later query can skip it.
Remove 4: count drops to 1 right away, but the heap keeps its stale entry. `pending[4]` becomes 1, so a later query can skip it.
The top of the heap is 6, but `pending[6]` is 1. This entry stands for an item that was removed, so it is discarded and the count stays 1.
The top of the heap is 4, but `pending[4]` is 1. This entry stands for an item that was removed, so it is discarded and the count stays 1.
The top of the heap is 1 and `pending[1]` is 0, so this entry is still in the multiset. It is the maximum.
